title: World Bloom — Link the Beats! — Episode10 So Much Mystery!

meta.Event Outline: VIRTUAL SINGERS in each SEKAI are caring for their respective trees when they are vanished away by a mysterious light. Witnessing this, their counterparts in the space between worlds enter SEKAI to search for them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's see... I'm fairly certain that this is where band me was sent...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I thought I saw a flash of light...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's right... I was playing in the station...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: With Rin... Wait, where did she go?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But thank goodness...
I'm not the only one who was sent here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Rin, wake up...
You can't sleep here.

rows.Speaker: Detective Plushie
rows.Line: Hm? You look familiar... But also suspicious!

rows.Speaker: Detective Plushie
rows.Line: Enough! Stay still while I tie you up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Sh-She isn't waking up...
Actually, it's amazing how she can sleep through all this...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But if I don't do something...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
We need to run.
Sorry about this, Rin.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
This should be far enough...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What do we do? Where do we run...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(This is really getting out of hand...
First, they're sent over to an unfamiliar SEKAI, and now they're being chased around...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I wish I could help them somehow.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... it doesn't look like she's here either.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: MEIKO said she'd be watering the tree in the harbor, but where could she have gone...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Alright, everything should be fine now.
That plushie seems to understand what's going on.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sorry for making you help us like this. And thank you for convincing him...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, don't worry about that.
More importantly...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Why are there two of us here now, right...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I don't know myself.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: When I came to, I was here with Rin...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, I never expected to meet myself from a different SEKAI. This all feels a bit strange to me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I did feel a little uneasy about being sent to an unfamiliar place, but I'm glad I was able to meet you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean, you just seem so reliable.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (And band me seems to be feeling much better now.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
KAAIITOO!
Watch me do a quadruple Axel♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I stuck the landing☆
But everything's spinning round and round now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh? Why are there two KAITOs?
Is it because I spun around too much just now?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Calm down, Miku.
Another me from a different SEKAI is here to visit us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I'm yet to find MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really?
Where could she have gone...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO, what's the SEKAI that you came from like?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, umm... My SEKAI is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know what that is! It's a guitar, right?! Tsukasa went all vraang using a broom during a show once!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Please try to settle down, Miku...
I think you're scaring him a little.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? I'm scaring you? Why's that?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sorry. She's very excited about meeting someone from another SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (She's so different from the Miku from my SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO!
We should give him a tour of this SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
We should.
If he doesn't know anything about this place, it's only natural he'd be uneasy...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Would you like for us to show you around?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Umm... Yes.
If it isn't too much trouble...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh? Hey, it's Rin!
Has she been taking a nap this whole time?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes...
She did stay up very late last night practicing...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In that case, we should probably let her sleep.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, I'll keep an eye on her.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I wouldn't want anything happening to her.

rows.Speaker: Chick Plushie
rows.Line: We'll keep an eye on Rin for you!

rows.Speaker: Bear Plushie
rows.Line: When she wakes up, we'll let you guys know!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, thanks so much, you guys!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure she'll be fine with them keeping an eye on her. What do you think? We understand your concern, so it's okay if you'd rather stay.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'm still not used to the thought of talking plushies...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But they don't seem like bad people, and I am interested in learning more about this SEKAI since it's so different...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, if you all don't mind, can you watch her for us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Take you on a trip to our wonderland!!
Happy wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's a sort of magic spell that the ones whose feelings created this SEKAI like to say.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start by going this way.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: For a second, I wasn't sure what was going to happen, but he should be okay now, I think.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
KAITO!
This is the amusement park♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: S-So many things are floating in the air...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Come on, this way!
There's more cool stuff that you gotta see♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What, what, what?
What's wrong, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, is that all?
It's a flower, silly! Of course it's gonna sing☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I understand why you're surprised, but these sorts of things are normal for this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Next, KAITO, we're gonna have a race to see who gets to that castle first!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha...
Miku seems to be having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is the Miku from your SEKAI not like her?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Nod*
She's much more cool and collected...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that's interesting. I'd like to meet her someday.

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line:
Heeey, slowpokes!
I'm gonna win if you guys don't hurry!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's chase after her, shall we?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
We never came close to catching her.
You could've gone a little easier on us, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay☆ Next time, I'll be more of a turtle♪
Ready, steady...

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: You're the other KAITO they told me about, right?!

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line:
Hmm... You do seem different!
I'll hang out with you if you want!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (He's being pulled in all directions. Is he going to be okay...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it might be good for him to experience something like this for a change.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The one whose feelings made this SEKAI seems to have arrived. Why don't you introduce yourself to him?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Don't worry!
Tsukasa's a really kind and energetic person☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Plus, KAITO and I really wanna introduce you!
So, let's go☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(Band me is a very shy person...
I'm a little worried.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But this could be a good experience for him. I'll be rooting for him.)
